meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会把仓库所有 open issue 和 PR 逐条拆成独立后台任务分析,把结论写成报告存到 /tmp/{日期时间}/,每条结论必须附 GitHub 永久链接作证据。它不在 GitHub 上做任何写操作。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词,或要求对仓库的 issue/PR 做只读分诊时触发,接管后逐条分析并写报告。

say.note: 拉取所有 open issue 逐条分析并写报告
分析所有 open PR,每个输出一份报告文件
对全部 open issue 与 PR 一起分诊,只出报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude pulls every open issue/PR, spawns one background task per item, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim needs a GitHub permalink. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs" and similar phrases, when you want a read-only pass over the repo's open issues and PRs.

say_en.note: Fetches all open issues and writes a report per issue
Analyzes every open PR and writes one report each
Triages all open issues and PRs together, reports only
